product.title: Korean Cooking Class with Full-Course Meal & Local Market Tour in Seoul

description.text: In Seoul, this three-and-a-half-hour home class meets at Mangwon Station Exit 2, walks Mangwon Market for street-food snacks and ingredients, then cooks four Korean dishes such as dakgalbi, bibimbap, haemul pajeon, or doenjang jjigae. A hanjeongsik spread of more than ten side dishes, dessert, beverages, and makgeolli is listed. The format suits visitors who want a guided home-kitchen meal rather than a kimchi-only session. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Seoul, and the itinerary stays on Mangwon Market and the home kitchen that define this class rather than a Gwangjang night walk.

highlights: Four Korean dishes and hanjeongsik sides

start.description: Meet outside Exit 2 of Mangwon Station on the brown subway line in Seoul.

end.description: Return to your Seoul meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
